The execution failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in campaign margins and total annual margin calculations.
The test_rows_and_order failed with 'close(468.0, 7956.0)' returning False, indicating a mismatch in campaign-level financial data. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed because the calculated total_annual_margin_6_day_usd was -45894.84 instead of the expected -83406.84. While the environment setup and 3 tests passed, the core logic for cost-benefit aggregation in /tests/test_outputs.py is producing incorrect values.
